heading: What Is Cowboy Fine Art Photography?
subtitles: Character over costume. Presence over pose. The cowboy treated as fine art, not nostalgia.

bridge.title: Cowboy fine art photography begins when the figure becomes more than a symbol.
bridge.intro: These images treat the cowboy through painterly light, narrative restraint, and psychological presence—where character matters more than costume and atmosphere carries more weight than spectacle.
